title: Snoop Dogg Reveals He Turned Down A $2 Million DJ Gig From Michael Jordan, And He Still Wants To Meet Him & Smoke A Blunt
htmlContent:
Snoop Dogg has done almost everything you can do as an entertainer, worked with some of the world's most excellent musicians, acted, and been in some of your favorite commercials. He even headlined last year's Super Bowl with Dr. Dre, 50 Cent, Kendrick Lamar, Mary J. Blige, and Eminem in Los Angeles.

He even once turned down a $2 million DJ gig for basketball great Michael Jordan. Snoop revealed this on Logan Paul's "Impaulsive" Podcast.

"I think one of the craziest deals that I turned down was like $2 million to DJ for I think it was a Michael Jordan event and I never met Michael Jordan. And I still want to meet him," said Snoop.

Why did he turn it down?

"Because I was doing some other s*** and had s*** to do one, I had way more customers before I got to you. Naw, I never met Michael Jordan, and I want to meet him, but I want to meet him on a different, not as a DJ, but as a fan as a boss. It's like Mike. I love you since North Carolina. I'm a big fan our yours. You are one of the greatest ever to do it, and give me a couple of secrets about how you did this. Can I get a picture with you? Do you want to smoke a blunt? Hey man, it has been real."

Speaking on Snoop, he recently showed support for his cousin Sasha Bank, who was recently suspended from WWE for working out a couple of weeks ago.
